subject: Re: Partnership with us?
body: Hi! Thanks for reaching out. I'd love to hear more about what the partnership involves. What kind of content are you looking for, and what does compensation look like? I post mostly reels and the odd long-form piece.

subject: Quick question before I commit
body: This looks good overall. Before I sign anything, can you confirm whether I'd still be able to work with other brands in the same space? That's the one thing that would stop me.

subject: Can we move our call?
body: Sorry for the short notice, something has come up on a job site. Could we push Thursday's call to next week? Any morning works for me.

subject: Posted it this morning
body: Just went live with the reel, link below. Let me know if you need anything else for the campaign. https://example.com/p/demo-reel-1

subject: Re: Offer
body: Thanks for the offer. I was hoping for something closer to the upper end given my audience has grown about 30% since we first spoke. Is there room to move?

subject: Not right now
body: Appreciate you thinking of me, but I'm fully booked with brand work until the new year. Happy to revisit in Q1 if that works.

subject: Invoice for October
body: Attaching my invoice for October's deliverables. Let me know if you need it in a different format for your finance team.

subject: Loved the new feature
body: No action needed, just wanted to say the scheduling update you shipped is great. I showed it in a story and people kept asking about it.
